query:
insert into campaign_leads (campaign_id, lead_id, current_step, next_run_at)
        select $1, l.id, 0, now()
        from leads l
        where l.list_id = $2
          and l.org_id = $3
          and l.status = 'active'
          and not exists (
              select 1 from suppressions s
              where s.org_id = l.org_id and lower(s.email) = lower(l.email)
          )
        on conflict (campaign_id, lead_id) do nothing
